Government explores ethanol as cooking fuel option

The government is reportedly examining plans to introduce ethanol as a mainstream cooking fuel, potentially alongside LPG. This initiative involves exploring subsidy mechanisms and developing a supply chain for wider adoption. The move follows previous considerations of ethanol for other uses, with the aim of potentially making cooking gas more affordable.
